title: 3DO DevBench — OS · Graphics
subtitle: Spectral Keep running in the patched Opera emulator · ./3do devbench · :3330

items.label: Session picker
items.text: Every running emulator session (DevBench's own, ./3do run windows, headless MCP sessions); every tab shows the one chosen here.

items.label: OS views
items.text: Each view walks a different Portfolio OS structure in guest RAM: tasks, items, ports, semaphores, devices, folios, graphics, audio, files, memory map, snapshots.

items.label: Filter
items.text: Filter the table by any text (name, type, address).

items.label: Auto-refresh
items.text: Reload the view every 2 s while the game runs.

items.label: Graphics
items.text: Screen groups, screens and bitmaps with size and framebuffer address (links open it in Memory) (MCP: os_inspect('graphics')).
